name: QR_Rule_01: Password Brute-Force & Account Lockout
description: Detects five or more failed logons from the same source within five minutes, or a Windows account lockout event.
gpo_policy: Account lockout threshold: 5 failed attempts; account lockout duration: 15 minutes.
expression: SELECT sourceip, username, "Event ID", COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM events WHERE "Event ID" = '4625' GROUP BY sourceip, username, "Event ID" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test 1: Event ID equals 4625 and at least 5 events share the same Source IP and Username within 5 minutes. Test 2 (OR): Event ID equals 4740. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by Source IP.
